original.target_description: Study 1: intervention versus brochure control, baseline to immediate postcourse proactive coping skills; group x time repeated-measures ANOVA.

n.sample_role: Participants in the proactive-coping repeated-measures analysis: 64 course participants and 73 control patients.
n.exclusions: Restricted to patients stating a goal at both T1 and T2; the 180 questionnaire completers (78 intervention, 102 control) are not the target analytic sample. Recruitment allocated 119 intervention and 108 control; intervention dropouts were 30 before and 11 during the course, and control dropouts were four due to ill-health and two due to form-completion difficulties.

n.exclusions: From 160 recruited: four with only one nonbaseline questionnaire, fourteen with no questionnaires, and one who attended no group sessions were excluded. Baseline-only respondents and 13 with no baseline but at least two later questionnaires were retained.

notes:
Original acquired from https://postprint.nivel.nl/PPpp3147.pdf; title and DOI verified. Replication DOI landing inaccessible; OpenAlex identified Utrecht OA repository, but repository and linked full PDFs returned 403. No abstract-only statistics extracted. Analytic group sample sizes are preserved as printed. 
Source follow-up: Published 2014 article copy (DOI contains 2013). Target description requests a control comparison, but initial intervention was provided to all participants. Printed standardised initial-phase slope retained with target_match false. No frequentist same-test p printed; Bayesian 90% credibility intervals .01;.50 (proactive coping), .04;.59 (self-efficacy). PPP is model fit, not slope p. PDF10 rendered and checked. Narrative verdict concerns original intervention; booster added value uncertain.
Completion source review (n_r): The explicitly retained analytic sample is 141 participants and LGCM uses all available data; no sums of assessment counts or derivation from df. The located model has no untreated-control comparison, so target_match=false.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly describe effective initial-phase improvements maintained over more than a year, in line with previous findings. This narrative verdict does not establish an untreated-control contrast; boosters are discussed separately.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Table 1 explicitly labels standardised estimates; the outcome-named initial-phase β1 is .23. This is within-intervention growth, not the control contrast in the assigned description; target_match=false. Other phase-specific estimates are retained in notes.
